content.title: Dollar Tumbles Against the Yen
content.summary: A dollar was trading for about 155.68 yen, down from 158.42 late Thursday after its worst day against the Japanese currency since Aug. 1.  It was the lowest 5 p.m. rate for the U.S. dollar against the yen since Dec. 18.  Friday in Japan, the country's central bank held rates steady, avoiding a surprise that could have jolted markets already unnerved by fiscal anxiety.
